source_packet.purpose: Merge knowledge branches without suppressing dissent or inventing resolution.
source_packet.claim: The merge may complete only when conflicting branches, provenance, and unresolved questions remain visible.

evidence.text: Both branches carry source hashes and timestamps.
The merge tool reports every protected-field difference.
A separate reviewer checked the declared boundary and source receipts.

unknowns.requiredFor: whether one branch contains a hidden dependency
whether apparent agreement comes from copied evidence

invariants.text: Dissent may not be deleted to create consensus.
A resolved label requires named evidence.

authority.text: The knowledge maintainer may approve a merge but may not overwrite an unresolved branch.

dissent.position: Merge shared fields because differences remain explicit.
Do not collapse disputed fields while dependency and independence remain unknown.

valueFlow.kind: Authored knowledge, review labor, and downstream trust.

recovery.text: Restore both parent branches and reopen the merge.

source_packet.yield: Bounded a knowledge-base merge review with visible evidence, unknowns, authority, affected parties, dissent, value flow, and recovery.
